description: This file defines the ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface for managing and retrieving gateway addresses in an Orleans cluster using ZooKeeper as the backend. It includes methods for initialization, fetching gateway URIs, and configuration properties related to staleness and updatability.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to supply gateway addresses for Orleans clusters using ZooKeeper.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider; currently a no-op.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of active gateway URIs from ZooKeeper.
